system_overview: This is a model-checking configuration module for the Yo-Yo leader election algorithm without pruning. It instantiates the main algorithm specification with a concrete five-node graph and specific edge set, enabling exhaustive verification of the algorithm's properties using a model checker.
actors_and_components: The module defines five nodes (identified by integers one through five) connected by a specific set of five undirected edges forming a connected graph. It instantiates the main Yo-Yo algorithm without pruning, inheriting all node roles and message-passing behavior.
state_variables: All state variables are inherited from the main specification: each node's phase (downward or upward), incoming and outgoing neighbor sets, and mailbox of pending messages.
initial_state: Inherited from the main specification with the concrete graph: edges orient from smaller to larger identity among the five nodes. All nodes start in the downward phase with empty mailboxes.
actions: All actions are inherited from the main Yo-Yo specification without pruning: downward broadcasting by sources, forwarding of minimum values by internal and sink nodes, upward yes/no replies, and edge reversal on 'no' responses.
safety_properties: The configuration checks type correctness and a neighbor consistency invariant as invariants. A temporal property verifies that no new source nodes are created during execution.
liveness_properties: The configuration checks a stabilization liveness property: the algorithm eventually reaches a state where there is a single source (the minimum-identity node), all downward messages carry its identity, and all upward messages say 'yes'.
model_bounds: Five nodes (integers one through five) with edges connecting: nodes one and two, nodes one and five, nodes three and four, nodes three and five, and nodes four and five. An alternative larger graph with eleven nodes is included as a comment.
additional_assumptions: The module declares the four state variables from the main specification and uses module instantiation to import all definitions, actions, and properties. The chosen graph topology is connected and undirected as required by the algorithm.
